title: Better Command Blocks
description: A better command block texture, LabPBR support!
body:
GGWoof's Better Command Block Texture.

I made this resource pack because I realized that there weren't any 3D command block resource packs I could find. I also made it for a modpack I'm working on called FabriStorm to better represent the command block from Minecraft: Story Mode.

Features:

  - Glowing command block buttons
  - Height map included for better accuracy

**LabPBR recommended**
